Tooooootally ''harmless.''<nowiki></nowiki>''"<br />"''You're ''sure'' about that?|Two [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s stationed on Hakara, before being put out of commission by a swarm of Hakarans|<ref name="A Little Help on Hakara" />}}
The '''Hakarans''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] hailing from the swamp [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hakara/Legends|Hakara]]. The Hakarans remained unknown to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] until the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when they requested aid from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to fight off [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] that had invaded their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] [[Mission to Hakara|arrived]] on Hakara and taught the Hakarans how to defeat the [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. With the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] help, the Hakarans were able to liberate their planet.

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|Check out these ''swarms!'' Looks like we found ''Hakara's'' native population!''"<br />"''I guess we shouldn't be so surprised. We already know that intelligent life comes in a variety of forms&hellip;|Ahsoka Tano and Anakin Skywalker, on the Hakarans|<ref name="A Little Help on Hakara" />}}
The Hakarans were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of tiny [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoids]] capable of flight. Due to their small size, they were easily confused for non-sentient [[Insect/Legends|insects]]. The Hakarans usually massed in large swarms. They had their own [[Hakaran language|language]] and were also able to communicate by forming a swarm in the shape of an object or a symbol; the latter way of communication was especially useful to convey information to individuals who did not know the Hakarans' language. The Hakarans lived in underground dwellings connected to the surface by [[Tree/Legends|tree]] hollows, and they possessed some form of technology to send signals off-world. The Hakarans were quick learners, able to grasp new technological concepts rapidly.<ref name="A Little Help on Hakara" />

==History==
{{Quote|Given a choice, I'd rather face the entire ''Droid Army'' than these pesky insects.|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], mistaking the Hakarans for non-sentient insects|<ref name="A Little Help on Hakara" />}}
[[File:Bugs_vs._Droids.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Hakarans attack Confederate battle droids.]]
The Hakarans were the only indigenous species of the swamp planet [[Hakara/Legends|Hakara]], which the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] believed uninhabited at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], although the Hakarans themselves were aware of the existence of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="A Little Help on Hakara" /> At some point during the first [[22 BBY/Legends|two]] [[21 BBY/Legends|years]] of the war,<ref name="Date">In ''[[A Little Help on Hakara]]'', [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] appears in her original costume from ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', indicating that the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] takes place prior to the episode "[[Heroes on Both Sides]]," in which she [https://web.archive.org/web/20110902130558/http://www.starwars.com/theclonewars/guide/episode310.html receives a new outfit] to signify the passage of [[Time/Legends|time]]. "Heroes on Both Sides" can be dated to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] since it occurs between two episodes, "[[ARC Troopers (episode)|ARC Troopers]]" and "[[Pursuit of Peace]]," that are also placed in 21 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] by two other sources: {{FactFile2014|62|21 BBY 17-18|Defence of Kamino}} and {{FactFile2014|7|KAT 1-2|King Katuunko}}, respectively. Therefore, ''A Little Help on Hakara'' must take place after the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], but no later than 21 BBY, the date of "Heroes on Both Sides."</ref> Hakara was invaded by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and a detachment of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] was stationed on the planet in order to steal the planet's natural resources. The Confederacy knew of the Hakarans, but they did not consider them to be a threat to their operation. Hoping to receive help from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], the Hakarans used their native technology to send a distress signal to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. The [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] received the message, but they were unable to decipher most of it because they were unfamiliar with the Hakaran language. Still, the Council conjectured that the strange message was in fact a call for help and thus [[Mission to Hakara|sent]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to Hakara to investigate.<ref name="A Little Help on Hakara" />

Upon arrival, the two Jedi mistook the Hakarans for nothing more than importunate insects, until a group of Hakarans saved them from a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]]&ndash;mounted [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] on patrol. The Jedi then realized that the insects possessed sentience and, by using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], taught them how to deactivate the [[Droid/Legends|droids]]' [[neural processor]]s. With the new knowledge, the Hakarans raided a Confederate [[Hakara Separatist base|platform]] and dispatched all B1 battle droids and [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]] stationed there. While the Hakarans finished off the remaining stragglers scattered throughout Hakara, Tano and Skywalker left the planet to inform the Jedi Council about the Hakarans. Skywalker hoped that the Council would place Hakara under their protection to prevent another invasion, and that the Jedi would suggest that the Republic send an [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] to the planet.<ref name="A Little Help on Hakara" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hakarans are featured in "[[A Little Help on Hakara]]", a short [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] strip published in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.9|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic'' 6.9]] in [[June]] of [[2010]] and written by [[Tom DeFalco]]. In the comic, the Hakarans are illustrated by [[Tanya Roberts]].<ref name="A Little Help on Hakara" />
